## About
Any Roof Repair & Installation is a family-owned and operated roofing company based on Curtner Ave in San Jose. We repair, maintain and install roofs for our neighbors here and throughout Santa Clara County, including Milpitas, Campbell, Santa Clara and Cupertino.
After years of repairing roofs in San Jose, we've found the main cause of leaks is lack of maintenance. And when a roof does leak, the wet spot you see isn't always where the water is getting in. So we locate the problem first, then fix it.
Sometimes a repair is the smart move, and sometimes a new roof is. We'll inspect it, give you the time, costs, warranty and cosmetic results, and work out the best solution with you. We're rated 5 on Google from 34 reviews, and one first-time homeowner said we walked him through everything step by step.

## Services
- Roof Repair: We fix all types of roofing, including clay, metal and asphalt shingles.
- Leaking Roof Repair: Wet spot on the ceiling or high on a wall? Don't wait it out. Fixing leaking roofs in San Jose is daily work for us.
- Emergency roof repair: When it can't wait, we can be there the same day.
- Residential Roof Repair: Repairs for San Jose homes, done so the issue won't come back anytime soon.
- Roof Maintenance: Regular inspections, cleaning and spot repairs to head off bigger problems later.
- Gutter Repair: Gutter repair for homes in San Jose.
- Re-Roofing: Re-roofing for residential and commercial roofs, whether part of the roof or the whole thing.
- New construction roof installation: We work with home builders in San Jose so every new home is a success from the top down.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge to look at my roof?
A: No. We'll come out and do a professional roof inspection and assessment free of charge, and tell you whether we can repair it or if it needs replacing.

Q: Should I repair my roof or replace it?
A: It depends on the roof. After a thorough inspection we'll go over the time to complete the project, costs, warranty and cosmetic results, and decide with you.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. We're licensed and insured to do any type of roof repair or installation in San Jose.

Q: What kinds of roofs do you work on?
A: All types, including clay, metal and asphalt shingles.
